epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the remote wilderness of the Carpathian Mountains lives an elusive predator that has inspired awe and fear throughout history: the Eurasian wolf. Discover the vital role that these once-misunderstood hunters play in protecting their ecosystem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在地理和生物學尺度上,人類只是霎眼間的存在罷了,但我們卻影響了許多動物的進化路徑.探索人類對狗,狼,郊狼和大象等的影響.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In geological and biological scales, humans have only been around for the blink of an eye, and yet weve managed to influence the evolutionary path for many animals. Explore the human impact on dogs, wolves, coyotes, elephants, and more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 波奈的裙礁是過千種珊瑚,魚類和其他海洋動物的家園,也是許多令人驚嘆的沉船的墓園.這些殘骸隨著時日的推移而進化成人工珊瑚,支撐著令人難以置信的多樣性海洋棲息地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bonaires fringing reef is home to thousands of species of corals, fish and other marine animals. It is also home to a collection of stunning shipwrecks. These wrecks evolve over time, becoming artificial reefs that support an incredibly diverse m...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨四個不同物種的四個家族-足智多謀的海灘族,好戰的沙漠族,紀律嚴明的河族和愛好和平的山族,找出這些靈長類成為非洲最成功動物之一的原因.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow four families of four different species - the resourceful Beach Troop, the warlike Desert Troop, the disciplined River Troop, and the peaceful Mountain Band - to find out why these primates are among the most successful animals in Africa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪地土的盡頭,一個極具生命力的自然劇場正在眼前上演.從微小的蝴蝶到巨大的座頭鯨,他們都走在地球演化的最前線,透過不斷改變行為來適應千變萬化的生境,並幫助我們解開對這個藍色星球的種種謎團.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to the ends of the Earth, where a drama is unfolding in real time. Meet animals, from tiny butterflies to huge humpback whales, that are acting as sentinels, adapting their behaviour, and helping us unlock the riddles of our changing planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 散落在不同海洋上的島嶼,其多樣性超乎想像;演化亦在你眼前發生.從加拉帕戈斯群島走到南極洲,看看海獅,雀鳥,蟋蟀,猴子和其他野生動物,如何以驚人的適應力來應對氣候變化問題.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Find out why islands are like mini-Earths where evolution happens before your eyes. Journey from the Galápagos to Antarctica to see how sea lions, finches, crickets, monkeys and other wildlife are finding surprising solutions to climatic problems.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從撒哈拉到荒野,於極端環境中學習動物如何適應急速變化的氣候並掙扎求存.與黑猩猩一起在洞穴中避難,看看駱駝以特別技巧飲用鹽水,並傾聽斑胸草雀為蛋寶寶由唱的歌,了解歌聲如何讓幼雛變得細小.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go to extremes, from the Sahara to the outback, where animals are teaching us how to survive in our heating world. Shelter in caves with chimps, see camels sip salt water, and listen as zebra finches sing to their eggs to make their chicks smaller.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起走訪迅速融化的極地,看看動物向科學家們留下有關我們未來存留的啟示與線索.了解北極熊,企鵝和其他極地生物的動靜如何幫助人類制定應對全球暖化之計.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek to the planets quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map (and prevent) global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上非常重要,卻受到忽視的棲息地之一,了解草原在減緩氣候變化上的角色,其吸收碳的容量比森林更大.接着拜會野牛和美洲獅等關鍵物種,看看他們如何幫助恢復生態資源,並治癒我們的星球.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore one of Earths most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. Meet key species, such as bison and pumas, that could restore this resource and heal our planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著葉子的變化,農場裡的動物露出野性.公羊羅傑和哈米殊就像擁有大角般對決,爭奪霸主地位.母雞莎莉飛過雞舍,在季末遊覽農場.母豬舒娜生下小豬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch life on the farm adjust as the leaves start to turn, from the sheep whose woolly coats keep them warm during the first frost to the bees that feed on the last bit of nectar before hibernation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 農場裡的動物為一年中最短的日子專心準備.為免冬天太沉悶,牛群享受假日美食和演唱會.母豬舒娜忙著照料九隻貪玩的小豬,而公羊哈米殊被大眾情人邦妮嫌棄.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is coming, and the animals take advantage of autumns final bounty before the cold, barren months ahead. Watch some creatures search for respite indoors, while others arrive from far northern climates to settle in the ploughed fields.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭南島的西南角被巨大的山脈和蠻荒的太平洋所封閉.稀有的企鵝每天都被逼與巨型胡氏海獅進行貓捉老鼠的遊戲.而海獅也生活在一個動蕩的世界,幼獅必須對抗大自然才能生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience unbelievable acts of courage and loyalty by creatures trying to survive in the remote wilderness of New Zealands South Island. Face forest penguins feast and famine cycles, and explore the tumultuous world of newborn sea lions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新西蘭西南部,深邃的峽灣和潮汐形成的潟湖被綠色的雨林覆蓋.生活在黑暗峽灣港的生物通常棲息在深海.隨著冬季將至,寬吻海豚必須逃離牠們冰冷的峽灣,而在山河中,新西蘭長鰭鰻細聽大海的呼喚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how winters arrival triggers animal survival instincts in southwestern New Zealand. Track dolphins as they move to warmer waters to give their calves a fighting chance, and join longfin eels on an epic migration to their spawning grounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭東南岸是世上最富饒的漁場之一,也是海洋動物嬰孩從新丁長大成人之地.年輕的鯨魚,海豚和海豹學習捕獵;學習社會規則,甚至開始自己的冒險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world – the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults. Young whales, dolphins and seals learn to hunt, learn the rules of s...

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​衝過昆士蘭東南地區,在繁殖與捕蛇的季節逐步升溫時,觀看阿黛兒與米克迎戰一條東部棕蛇,這是世界上第二致命的毒蛇,同時史都與麗芙則與一條地毯蟒糾纏搏鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dash across southeast Queensland as breeding and snake-catching season ramp up. Watch Adele and Mick go up against an eastern brown, the second deadliest snake in the world, while Stu and Liv tangle with a carpet python.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​隨著春季的蛇潮展開,跟隨麗芙與史都一起,他們在工地現場攔截兩條為爭奪交配權而決鬥的公棕蛇,這是一場激烈的爭鬥,一場關乎交配資格的爭戰.退後站觀,觀看丹與潔絲從一條蟒蛇手中救出雞群,而米克與阿黛兒則追捕一條失控的綠樹蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Launch into springs snake surge with Liv and Stu, who intercept two male brown snakes duelling for mating rights at a construction site. Stand back as Dan and Jess rescue chickens from a python, and Mick and Adele hunt for a rogue green tree snake.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​穿梭於昆士蘭沿海的混亂景象與喧囂之中,傑絲勇敢面對她內心的恐懼,追逐一隻攀爬至樹上的蕾絲蜥蜴,而那棵樹上還棲息著活躍繁忙的蜂巢.觀看斯圖小心翼翼地將一條被困在籬笆之間的東方褐蛇救出,並觀察米克為驚慌不安的屋主捕捉那條滑溜難抓,靈活的巨蟒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Weave through Queenslands coastal chaos, where Jess faces her fears chasing a lace monitor lizard up a tree with an active beehive. Watch Stu cut a trapped eastern brown out of a fence and see Mick hunt a slippery python for terrified homeowners.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​潛入狹小緊迫的空間之中,鑽入溫室的底部結構,並進入緊張刺激的救援現場,捕蛇人勇敢面對一條長達六英尺,極度有毒的褐蛇.隨後觀看斯圖與莉芙將威脅到屋主寵物安全的沿海巨蟒小心搬遷至安全地點.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive into tight spaces, underneath hot houses, and into tense rescue situations as the catchers confront a six-foot-long, highly venomous brown snake. Then watch Stu and Liv relocate a coastal python threatening the safety of a homeowners pets.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​衝進嶄新的郊區社區,馴蛇專家努力阻止致命毒蛇滑入普通家庭住宅.觀看斯圖與莉芙將一條東方褐蛇從工地移出,傑絲與丹將巨蟒從倉庫中驅逐出去,而米克與阿黛爾則將紅腹蛇趕出臥室,確保屋主生活區域的安全.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Storm into a new suburb, where the wranglers keep deadly snakes from slipping into family homes. Watch as Stu and Liv pull an eastern brown from a job site, Jess and Dan expel a python from a shed, and Mick and Adele evict a red belly from a bedroom.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在偏遠農村地產面對危險時,米克與阿黛爾勇敢無畏地應對一條激烈攻擊的褐蛇.傑絲與丹小心翼翼地將巨蟒從遊樂區中救出,而當一條捕雞巨蟒在緊張危急的救援過程中壓住莉芙的手時,更令人心跳加速,驚慌不已.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Respond to danger on a rural property with Mick and Adele, who brave a fired-up brown snake. Tread carefully as Jess and Dan extract a python from a play area, and get spooked when a chicken-hunting python squashes Livs hand during a tense rescue.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在繁殖季節中與米克和阿黛爾一起糾纏不清,他們救了一隻被饑餓的蟒蛇威脅的傑克羅素犬.與米克一起在泳池中對抗一條致命的紅腹黑蛇,並與斯圖和莉芙一起在建築工地上處理東部棕蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​準備好進行一場火熱的救援,當丹和傑絲從後院移除交配中的東部棕蛇時,然後屏住呼吸,因為米克在沙發墊裡嗅出了一條高度有毒的蛇.稍後,觀看斯圖拆解一個雞舍以撬出一條地毯蟒蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 急診室團隊正忙著應對春季患者潮.在救援隊抵禦粗魯的袋鼠時,獸醫菲爾 (Phil) 穩定了一隻小袋鼠.高級獸醫蒂姆 (Tim) 為一隻被貓抓傷的袋狸治療,並從柵欄捉出一隻魚遊蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scramble as the ER team tends to a spring flood of patients. Watch vet Phil stabilize an ailing joey as the rescue team fends off a rude kangaroo. Shadow senior vet Tim, who treats a cat-scratched bandicoot and snakes a keelback out of a grate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與救援人員喬 (Jo) 一同去撈起一隻吞下魚鉤的鵜鶘,隨後看到山姆 (Sam) 解救了一隻纏在柵欄里的蝙蝠幼崽.跟隨獸醫蒂姆,他救助一隻眼睛感染且脾氣怪戾的考拉,並觀看一條笨重的蟒蛇給新手魯比 (Ruby) 帶來的麻煩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head out with rescuer Jo to scoop up a pelican whos swallowed a fish hook, then see Sam free a newborn bat tangled in a fence. Follow vet Tim, who aids a surly koala with an eye infection, and watch a lumpy python give newbie Ruby a load of trouble.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 影子獸醫貝克 (Bec) 為被狗咬傷的考拉瑞秋 (Rachel) 包扎傷口,新手獸醫魯比 (Ruby) 和克里恩 (Kerryn) 負責安撫一群不安分的負鼠.與救援人員丹妮 (Dani) 一起解救一對被困在墻上的笑翠鳥,並觀看獸醫蒂姆 (Tim) 為松鼠袋鼯進行的膝蓋手術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shadow vet Bec, who patches up dog-bitten koala Rachel, and new vets Ruby and Kerryn, who soothe a pack of itchy possums. Free a pair of kookaburras trapped in a wall with rescue officer Dani and watch vet Tims squirrel glider knee surgery.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​衝過昆士蘭東南地區,在繁殖與捕蛇的季節逐步升溫時,觀看阿黛兒與米克迎戰一條東部棕蛇,這是世界上第二致命的毒蛇,同時史都與麗芙則與一條地毯蟒糾纏搏鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dash across southeast Queensland as breeding and snake-catching season ramp up. Watch Adele and Mick go up against an eastern brown, the second deadliest snake in the world, while Stu and Liv tangle with a carpet python.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​隨著春季的蛇潮展開,跟隨麗芙與史都一起,他們在工地現場攔截兩條為爭奪交配權而決鬥的公棕蛇,這是一場激烈的爭鬥,一場關乎交配資格的爭戰.退後站觀,觀看丹與潔絲從一條蟒蛇手中救出雞群,而米克與阿黛兒則追捕一條失控的綠樹蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Launch into springs snake surge with Liv and Stu, who intercept two male brown snakes duelling for mating rights at a construction site. Stand back as Dan and Jess rescue chickens from a python, and Mick and Adele hunt for a rogue green tree snake.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​穿梭於昆士蘭沿海的混亂景象與喧囂之中,傑絲勇敢面對她內心的恐懼,追逐一隻攀爬至樹上的蕾絲蜥蜴,而那棵樹上還棲息著活躍繁忙的蜂巢.觀看斯圖小心翼翼地將一條被困在籬笆之間的東方褐蛇救出,並觀察米克為驚慌不安的屋主捕捉那條滑溜難抓,靈活的巨蟒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Weave through Queenslands coastal chaos, where Jess faces her fears chasing a lace monitor lizard up a tree with an active beehive. Watch Stu cut a trapped eastern brown out of a fence and see Mick hunt a slippery python for terrified homeowners.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​潛入狹小緊迫的空間之中,鑽入溫室的底部結構,並進入緊張刺激的救援現場,捕蛇人勇敢面對一條長達六英尺,極度有毒的褐蛇.隨後觀看斯圖與莉芙將威脅到屋主寵物安全的沿海巨蟒小心搬遷至安全地點.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive into tight spaces, underneath hot houses, and into tense rescue situations as the catchers confront a six-foot-long, highly venomous brown snake. Then watch Stu and Liv relocate a coastal python threatening the safety of a homeowners pets.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​衝進嶄新的郊區社區,馴蛇專家努力阻止致命毒蛇滑入普通家庭住宅.觀看斯圖與莉芙將一條東方褐蛇從工地移出,傑絲與丹將巨蟒從倉庫中驅逐出去,而米克與阿黛爾則將紅腹蛇趕出臥室,確保屋主生活區域的安全.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物界中一些最有趣的適應性是無形的.研究這些隱藏的內部變化,以觀察不同的動物如何用驚人且看不見的方式進化並生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some of the most interesting adaptations in the animal world are completely invisible. Study these hidden, internal alterations to see how different animals have evolved to survive in amazing and unseen ways.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​為家養驢凱許的生日慶祝,接著與臭鼬米爾頓玩捉迷藏.認識海狸比約納,他有一份非常重要的工作,並與樹袋鼠班特利及他的人類媽媽一起探索擁抱與午睡的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Celebrate Cash the house donkeys birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 對獅子來說,水牛固然是令人滿足的晚餐,但同時也是危險的獵物.與穆瓦姆巴獅群一起追蹤為數近三百頭水牛,並從中窺探他們的獵食技巧,他們必須迅速而謹慎地行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To the lion, the buffalo is not only a satisfying dinner but also dangerous. Track a herd of 300 buffalo along with the Mwamba pride, who must act quickly and carefully if they are to take down their prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象傳奇有三個故事.一頭牛犢穿越奧卡萬戈三角洲.一頭公牛正尋覓伴侶.一位女族長帶領家人穿過沙漠.這些個別的冒險故事一同敍述了非洲最具標誌性物種之一的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​來認識「濱水」獅群的成員吧:雄獅湯姆・湯姆與卡勒,八隻雌獅,十頭年輕的獅子,以及愛因斯坦,那頭從未離開家園,如今已長成的幼獅.當愛因斯坦的反叛之舉逐漸發酵,最終在「外來者」獅群的對手發動攻勢時,為他釘下了命運的定局.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get to know the Waterfront Pride: males Tom Tom and Caller, 8 lionesses, 10 youths, and Einstein, the grown cub who never left home. Watch Einsteins defiance catch up with him when rivals from the Outsiders Pride make a play that seals his fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退潮時露出一條稱為潮間帶的海岸.這是一個令人驚愕的極端之地,受到熱帶氣旋 風浪的衝擊,又暴露在酷熱中.這裡的生物以無數怪異的方式進化. 科學家們探索這個外星之境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. Its a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​來認識「濱水」獅群的成員吧:雄獅湯姆・湯姆與卡勒,八隻雌獅,十頭年輕的獅子,以及愛因斯坦,那頭從未離開家園,如今已長成的幼獅.當愛因斯坦的反叛之舉逐漸發酵,最終在「外來者」獅群的對手發動攻勢時,為他釘下了命運的定局.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get to know the Waterfront Pride: males Tom Tom and Caller, 8 lionesses, 10 youths, and Einstein, the grown cub who never left home. Watch Einsteins defiance catch up with him when rivals from the Outsiders Pride make a play that seals his fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退潮時露出一條稱為潮間帶的海岸.這是一個令人驚愕的極端之地,受到熱帶氣旋 風浪的衝擊,又暴露在酷熱中.這裡的生物以無數怪異的方式進化. 科學家們探索這個外星之境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. Its a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​為家養驢凱許的生日慶祝,接著與臭鼬米爾頓玩捉迷藏.認識海狸比約納,他有一份非常重要的工作,並與樹袋鼠班特利及他的人類媽媽一起探索擁抱與午睡的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Celebrate Cash the house donkeys birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 對獅子來說,水牛固然是令人滿足的晚餐,但同時也是危險的獵物.與穆瓦姆巴獅群一起追蹤為數近三百頭水牛,並從中窺探他們的獵食技巧,他們必須迅速而謹慎地行動.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​衝進嶄新的郊區社區,馴蛇專家努力阻止致命毒蛇滑入普通家庭住宅.觀看斯圖與莉芙將一條東方褐蛇從工地移出,傑絲與丹將巨蟒從倉庫中驅逐出去,而米克與阿黛爾則將紅腹蛇趕出臥室,確保屋主生活區域的安全.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Storm into a new suburb, where the wranglers keep deadly snakes from slipping into family homes. Watch as Stu and Liv pull an eastern brown from a job site, Jess and Dan expel a python from a shed, and Mick and Adele evict a red belly from a bedroom.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在偏遠農村地產面對危險時,米克與阿黛爾勇敢無畏地應對一條激烈攻擊的褐蛇.傑絲與丹小心翼翼地將巨蟒從遊樂區中救出,而當一條捕雞巨蟒在緊張危急的救援過程中壓住莉芙的手時,更令人心跳加速,驚慌不已.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Respond to danger on a rural property with Mick and Adele, who brave a fired-up brown snake. Tread carefully as Jess and Dan extract a python from a play area, and get spooked when a chicken-hunting python squashes Livs hand during a tense rescue.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 斑馬為何有斑紋?企鵝如何在水底看東西?為何樹蛙的眼睛是紅色的?在可見的探索中,發掘一些動物如何進化以達到極佳的視力,而另一些卻進化至幾乎隱形.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Why do zebras have stripes? How do penguins see underwater? And why are a tree frogs eyes red? In this exploration of sight, discover how some animals have evolved to see extremely well while others have evolved to be nearly invisible.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與地球上最快的動物運動員一起加速.觀看死亡加德蛇在瞬間出擊,與遊隼一起進行空中暗殺,與變色龍一起捕捉快速的食物,並面對在海雀俯衝獵物時的驚人G力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​在珊瑚街道中,生存從來不是理所當然,唯有適應,否則就得滅亡.​高於常態的溫度使得入秋冷卻變得更加困難,生存難度隨之攀升.暫住於小丑魚一家和他們那位海葵房東之間的共生之家,再看看清潔魚如何替魔鬼魟提供一場猶如水中溫泉會館般的療癒服務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapt or perish in the coral streets as higher-than-normal temperatures make autumn cooling (and survival) more difficult. Shack up with a clownfish family and their sea anemone landlord, then see cleaner fish give manta rays a day at the spa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​當寒冬降臨之際,沁入骨髓的寒意讓原本熱鬧喧騰的珊瑚礁世界趨於沉靜.隨著鏡頭悠然緩行,你將與礁鯊一同漫遊,與章魚共度水下時光;還會探訪一處奇妙的珊瑚綠洲,靜靜地矗立在一艘古老船骸之上.別錯過條紋蛇鰻高超的「身分竊取」本領:牠能巧妙偽裝成兇猛的掠食者,以迷惑周遭的生物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get chills as winter descends, slowing down life on the bustling reef. Meander with reef sharks and octopuses, visit a coral oasis atop an old shipwreck, and spot a banded snake eels talent for identity theft when it disguises itself as a predator.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙熱高溫,當獅群努力狩獵足夠食物,乾旱條件逼迫他們與獵物一同陷入接近死亡的險境,生命幾乎被推向邊緣.觀看愛因斯坦適應孤獨生活,然後評估戰場殘局,在新手母親卡爾維茲為幼崽性命而奮戰之後.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat when the pride tries to hunt down adequate food as drought conditions push them (and their prey) dangerously close to death. Watch Einstein adapt to solo life, then assess the damage after new mom Kalwezi fights for her cubs lives.

epg.programme_title_tc: 魚鷹: 海洋迅猛禽 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對老魚鷹回到康州鹽沼的家中.牠們在整個夏天必須與敵人作戰,忍耐惡劣天氣,捕獵千百條魚,只為養育下一代.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys whove been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在繁殖季節中與米克和阿黛爾一起糾纏不清,他們救了一隻被饑餓的蟒蛇威脅的傑克羅素犬.與米克一起在泳池中對抗一條致命的紅腹黑蛇,並與斯圖和莉芙一起在建築工地上處理東部棕蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​準備好進行一場火熱的救援,當丹和傑絲從後院移除交配中的東部棕蛇時,然後屏住呼吸,因為米克在沙發墊裡嗅出了一條高度有毒的蛇.稍後,觀看斯圖拆解一個雞舍以撬出一條地毯蟒蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與地球上最快的動物運動員一起加速.觀看死亡加德蛇在瞬間出擊,與遊隼一起進行空中暗殺,與變色龍一起捕捉快速的食物,並面對在海雀俯衝獵物時的驚人G力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​在珊瑚街道中,生存從來不是理所當然,唯有適應,否則就得滅亡.​高於常態的溫度使得入秋冷卻變得更加困難,生存難度隨之攀升.暫住於小丑魚一家和他們那位海葵房東之間的共生之家,再看看清潔魚如何替魔鬼魟提供一場猶如水中溫泉會館般的療癒服務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapt or perish in the coral streets as higher-than-normal temperatures make autumn cooling (and survival) more difficult. Shack up with a clownfish family and their sea anemone landlord, then see cleaner fish give manta rays a day at the spa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​當寒冬降臨之際,沁入骨髓的寒意讓原本熱鬧喧騰的珊瑚礁世界趨於沉靜.隨著鏡頭悠然緩行,你將與礁鯊一同漫遊,與章魚共度水下時光;還會探訪一處奇妙的珊瑚綠洲,靜靜地矗立在一艘古老船骸之上.別錯過條紋蛇鰻高超的「身分竊取」本領:牠能巧妙偽裝成兇猛的掠食者,以迷惑周遭的生物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get chills as winter descends, slowing down life on the bustling reef. Meander with reef sharks and octopuses, visit a coral oasis atop an old shipwreck, and spot a banded snake eels talent for identity theft when it disguises itself as a predator.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙熱高溫,當獅群努力狩獵足夠食物,乾旱條件逼迫他們與獵物一同陷入接近死亡的險境,生命幾乎被推向邊緣.觀看愛因斯坦適應孤獨生活,然後評估戰場殘局,在新手母親卡爾維茲為幼崽性命而奮戰之後.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat when the pride tries to hunt down adequate food as drought conditions push them (and their prey) dangerously close to death. Watch Einstein adapt to solo life, then assess the damage after new mom Kalwezi fights for her cubs lives.

epg.programme_title_tc: 魚鷹: 海洋迅猛禽 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對老魚鷹回到康州鹽沼的家中.牠們在整個夏天必須與敵人作戰,忍耐惡劣天氣,捕獵千百條魚,只為養育下一代.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys whove been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 對獅子來說,水牛固然是令人滿足的晚餐,但同時也是危險的獵物.與穆瓦姆巴獅群一起追蹤為數近三百頭水牛,並從中窺探他們的獵食技巧,他們必須迅速而謹慎地行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To the lion, the buffalo is not only a satisfying dinner but also dangerous. Track a herd of 300 buffalo along with the Mwamba pride, who must act quickly and carefully if they are to take down their prey.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在繁殖季節中與米克和阿黛爾一起糾纏不清,他們救了一隻被饑餓的蟒蛇威脅的傑克羅素犬.與米克一起在泳池中對抗一條致命的紅腹黑蛇,並與斯圖和莉芙一起在建築工地上處理東部棕蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

epg.programme_title_tc: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​準備好進行一場火熱的救援,當丹和傑絲從後院移除交配中的東部棕蛇時,然後屏住呼吸,因為米克在沙發墊裡嗅出了一條高度有毒的蛇.稍後,觀看斯圖拆解一個雞舍以撬出一條地毯蟒蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世上有多種合作形式.一些動物合作群居,而另一些動物則將群體利益置於自身的繁殖潛力之上.看看物種為了生存而進化成互相合作的眾多方式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cooperation comes in many forms. Some animals cooperate to be social while others put the welfare of the group above their own reproductive potential. See the many ways species have evolved to work with one another in order to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 齊來為年輕的格鬥士們鼓掌,並親眼見證他們在美洲茂密的熱帶森林中奮力拼搏!然後退後一步,觀察一隻毒箭蛙發動絕活攻勢,還有美洲豹和凱門鱷爭奪地盤,以及見證一隻飢餓的長鼻狸與猛蜘蛛的邂逅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cheer as young gladiators earn their stripes in the dense tropical forests of the Americas. Stand back as a poison dart frog launches a toxic barrage, observe a jaguar-caiman turf war, and see a hungry coati cross paths with a defensive tarantula.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穿梭於綠意盎然的城市,獮猴族長馬特諾爾以鐵腕手段,一直統治擁有30名成員的街頭部族.另一邊廂,老領袖阿拉夫則管理更具野性的深山部族.年少氣盛的洛基該挑戰哪一位的王者寶座?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the lush treed cityscape where fluffy male Matnoor rules over the 30-member-strong Street Troop with an iron fist. Then meet Aarav, the old alpha who oversees the wilder Hill Troop. Which will up-and-comer Loci challenge for the crown?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨街頭部族穿梭大街小巷,享受一次充滿垃圾食物的城市假期.鏡頭一轉,看看深山部族趁機入侵街頭部族的領地後,情勢如何急轉直下.目擊姐妹團如何組織綁架莎拉寶寶的陰謀,而新上任的領袖洛基則發現他的老對手已經重返城鎮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go on a junk-food-fuelled urban holiday with the Street Troop, then watch the Hill Troops invasion of their turf turn sour. Monitor the Sisterhoods plot to kidnap Saras baby before newly minted alpha Loci discovers his old rival is back in town.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​面對雨季的挑戰,這個季節讓一切轉為綠意盎然,同時破壞了獅子隱蔽的保護色,掩飾效果徹底失靈.觀看愛因斯坦無法建立新的聯繫,並權衡得失,在琪薩與牠的幼崽被敵對雄獅瘋眼穆迪綁走之時.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Contend with the challenges of the rainy season, which turns everything green and spoils the lions camouflage. Watch Einstein fail to make new connections and weigh the pros and cons when Keeza and her cub are kidnapped by rival male Mad-Eye Moody.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天釋放了她的鐵腕.冰島的北極狐在山間馬不停蹄地交配.一隻水獺在設得蘭群島養育孩兒.大量的馴鹿群在挪威下山產子.三月的一場風暴橫掃暴風之地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter releases her iron grip. In Iceland Arctic foxes scurry across mountains to mate. In Shetland an otter raises her cubs. In Norway a vast reindeer herd descends to the calving grounds. A huge March storm rages across the Stormborn lands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 急診室團隊正忙著應對春季患者潮.在救援隊抵禦粗魯的袋鼠時,獸醫菲爾 (Phil) 穩定了一隻小袋鼠.高級獸醫蒂姆 (Tim) 為一隻被貓抓傷的袋狸治療,並從柵欄捉出一隻魚遊蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scramble as the ER team tends to a spring flood of patients. Watch vet Phil stabilize an ailing joey as the rescue team fends off a rude kangaroo. Shadow senior vet Tim, who treats a cat-scratched bandicoot and snakes a keelback out of a grate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​面對雨季的挑戰,這個季節讓一切轉為綠意盎然,同時破壞了獅子隱蔽的保護色,掩飾效果徹底失靈.觀看愛因斯坦無法建立新的聯繫,並權衡得失,在琪薩與牠的幼崽被敵對雄獅瘋眼穆迪綁走之時.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Contend with the challenges of the rainy season, which turns everything green and spoils the lions camouflage. Watch Einstein fail to make new connections and weigh the pros and cons when Keeza and her cub are kidnapped by rival male Mad-Eye Moody.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天釋放了她的鐵腕.冰島的北極狐在山間馬不停蹄地交配.一隻水獺在設得蘭群島養育孩兒.大量的馴鹿群在挪威下山產子.三月的一場風暴橫掃暴風之地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter releases her iron grip. In Iceland Arctic foxes scurry across mountains to mate. In Shetland an otter raises her cubs. In Norway a vast reindeer herd descends to the calving grounds. A huge March storm rages across the Stormborn lands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​在珊瑚街道中,生存從來不是理所當然,唯有適應,否則就得滅亡.​高於常態的溫度使得入秋冷卻變得更加困難,生存難度隨之攀升.暫住於小丑魚一家和他們那位海葵房東之間的共生之家,再看看清潔魚如何替魔鬼魟提供一場猶如水中溫泉會館般的療癒服務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapt or perish in the coral streets as higher-than-normal temperatures make autumn cooling (and survival) more difficult. Shack up with a clownfish family and their sea anemone landlord, then see cleaner fish give manta rays a day at the spa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​當寒冬降臨之際,沁入骨髓的寒意讓原本熱鬧喧騰的珊瑚礁世界趨於沉靜.隨著鏡頭悠然緩行,你將與礁鯊一同漫遊,與章魚共度水下時光;還會探訪一處奇妙的珊瑚綠洲,靜靜地矗立在一艘古老船骸之上.別錯過條紋蛇鰻高超的「身分竊取」本領:牠能巧妙偽裝成兇猛的掠食者,以迷惑周遭的生物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get chills as winter descends, slowing down life on the bustling reef. Meander with reef sharks and octopuses, visit a coral oasis atop an old shipwreck, and spot a banded snake eels talent for identity theft when it disguises itself as a predator.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 急診室團隊正忙著應對春季患者潮.在救援隊抵禦粗魯的袋鼠時,獸醫菲爾 (Phil) 穩定了一隻小袋鼠.高級獸醫蒂姆 (Tim) 為一隻被貓抓傷的袋狸治療,並從柵欄捉出一隻魚遊蛇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scramble as the ER team tends to a spring flood of patients. Watch vet Phil stabilize an ailing joey as the rescue team fends off a rude kangaroo. Shadow senior vet Tim, who treats a cat-scratched bandicoot and snakes a keelback out of a grate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穿梭於綠意盎然的城市,獮猴族長馬特諾爾以鐵腕手段,一直統治擁有30名成員的街頭部族.另一邊廂,老領袖阿拉夫則管理更具野性的深山部族.年少氣盛的洛基該挑戰哪一位的王者寶座?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the lush treed cityscape where fluffy male Matnoor rules over the 30-member-strong Street Troop with an iron fist. Then meet Aarav, the old alpha who oversees the wilder Hill Troop. Which will up-and-comer Loci challenge for the crown?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨街頭部族穿梭大街小巷,享受一次充滿垃圾食物的城市假期.鏡頭一轉,看看深山部族趁機入侵街頭部族的領地後,情勢如何急轉直下.目擊姐妹團如何組織綁架莎拉寶寶的陰謀,而新上任的領袖洛基則發現他的老對手已經重返城鎮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go on a junk-food-fuelled urban holiday with the Street Troop, then watch the Hill Troops invasion of their turf turn sour. Monitor the Sisterhoods plot to kidnap Saras baby before newly minted alpha Loci discovers his old rival is back in town.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有人稱牠們為「活化石」,但這只是對倖存者的另一個稱呼.從鯊魚到鱟,這些動物的早期適應都十分成功,讓牠們數百萬年來相對地保持不變.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some call them living fossils, but thats just another way to say survivors. From the shark to the horseshoe crab, these animals early adaptations were a success, leaving them relatively unchanged for millions of years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穿梭於綠意盎然的城市,獮猴族長馬特諾爾以鐵腕手段,一直統治擁有30名成員的街頭部族.另一邊廂,老領袖阿拉夫則管理更具野性的深山部族.年少氣盛的洛基該挑戰哪一位的王者寶座?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the lush treed cityscape where fluffy male Matnoor rules over the 30-member-strong Street Troop with an iron fist. Then meet Aarav, the old alpha who oversees the wilder Hill Troop. Which will up-and-comer Loci challenge for the crown?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go on a junk-food-fuelled urban holiday with the Street Troop, then watch the Hill Troops invasion of their turf turn sour. Monitor the Sisterhoods plot to kidnap Saras baby before newly minted alpha Loci discovers his old rival is back in town.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往美國極北地帶,拜訪沿著水道生活的終極格鬥士.春回大地,看到融雪就知道格鬥隨時上演:鷹與鷺的對決,熊族對陣,以及蜻蜓蛹與大型水蟲之間的決鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head to Americas far north for a peek at the ultimate fighters that live along its waterways. See a spring thaw kick off the competition, pitting eagles against herons, bears against bears, and dragonfly nymphs against venomous giant water bugs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探小熊們在夏季如何學習爬樹和覓食,為重返野外生活做好準備.迎接一批新成員驚喜入營,見證熊寶貝們進入冬眠前的大吃特吃,並享受一場盛大的小熊感恩祭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spy on the summer cubs as they learn to climb trees and forage for food in preparation for their release into the wild. Get surprised by a set of new arrivals, observe the annual pre-hibernation eating binge, and enjoy a bear-friendly Thanksgiving.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨羅傑為夏季小熊的野放做好準備,然後一起認識兩位新來的小熊--艾斯和小藍莓;牠們因嚴重的健康問題,必須在營中暫住,與新一批小熊們一起過冬.最後,一同慶祝六隻健康快樂的熊寶貝踏上全新的野外生活.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prepare for the summer cubs release with Roger, then meet Ace and Little Blueberry, two newbies with serious health issues who will have to stay over the winter with the Z cubs. Later, celebrate as six healthy, happy bears embark on their new life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​迎來豐饒季節的問候,當洪水退去,大群獵物再度回到喬貝河岸邊,重現成群聚集的壯觀場景.觀看琪薩帶著幼崽嘗試逃離,卡勒與湯湯則與對手搏鬥激戰,然後歡呼愛因斯坦終於找到配偶.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Say hello to a season of plenty as flood waters recede and vast herds of prey return to the Chobes banks. Watch Keeza and her cub make a break for it while Caller and Tom Tom brawl with their enemies, then cheer when Einstein finally finds a mate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪北大西洋,與棲身其中的動物一起享受短暫而壯麗的夏季.跟隨北極狐寶寶學習捕獵技能以求生存,見證水獺幼寶寶進行第一次獨自冒險;跟隨海鸚尋找配偶,並一同見證小馴鹿邁出他們的第一步.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience the north Atlantics intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與救援人員喬 (Jo) 一同去撈起一隻吞下魚鉤的鵜鶘,隨後看到山姆 (Sam) 解救了一隻纏在柵欄里的蝙蝠幼崽.跟隨獸醫蒂姆,他救助一隻眼睛感染且脾氣怪戾的考拉,並觀看一條笨重的蟒蛇給新手魯比 (Ruby) 帶來的麻煩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head out with rescuer Jo to scoop up a pelican whos swallowed a fish hook, then see Sam free a newborn bat tangled in a fence. Follow vet Tim, who aids a surly koala with an eye infection, and watch a lumpy python give newbie Ruby a load of trouble.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prepare for the summer cubs release with Roger, then meet Ace and Little Blueberry, two newbies with serious health issues who will have to stay over the winter with the Z cubs. Later, celebrate as six healthy, happy bears embark on their new life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬達加斯加是地球上任何其他地方都找不到的奇怪動物的家.當這些動物為權位而戰,牠們的戰鬥也很奇特--從象鼻蟲怪異的脖子摔角,到環尾狐猴母嬰間的打鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Madagascar is home to strange animals not found anywhere else on Earth. When these animals fight for supremacy, their battles are just as strange - from weird neck-wrestling weevils to ring-tailed lemur moms that go into battle with baby on board.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探小熊們在夏季如何學習爬樹和覓食,為重返野外生活做好準備.迎接一批新成員驚喜入營,見證熊寶貝們進入冬眠前的大吃特吃,並享受一場盛大的小熊感恩祭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spy on the summer cubs as they learn to climb trees and forage for food in preparation for their release into the wild. Get surprised by a set of new arrivals, observe the annual pre-hibernation eating binge, and enjoy a bear-friendly Thanksgiving.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨羅傑為夏季小熊的野放做好準備,然後一起認識兩位新來的小熊--艾斯和小藍莓;牠們因嚴重的健康問題,必須在營中暫住,與新一批小熊們一起過冬.最後,一同慶祝六隻健康快樂的熊寶貝踏上全新的野外生活.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prepare for the summer cubs release with Roger, then meet Ace and Little Blueberry, two newbies with serious health issues who will have to stay over the winter with the Z cubs. Later, celebrate as six healthy, happy bears embark on their new life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在歐洲,喀爾巴阡山脈的偏遠荒野是由古老森林和陡峭峽谷組成的一片戲劇性土地.神秘生物在這處仍漫步野外,崎嶇的景觀是一種捕食者的家園,牠在整個歷史中刻下敬畏和恐懼:歐亞狼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the remote wilderness of the Carpathian Mountains lives an elusive predator that has inspired awe and fear throughout history: the Eurasian wolf. Discover the vital role that these once-misunderstood hunters play in protecting their ecosystem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​為家養驢凱許的生日慶祝,接著與臭鼬米爾頓玩捉迷藏.認識海狸比約納,他有一份非常重要的工作,並與樹袋鼠班特利及他的人類媽媽一起探索擁抱與午睡的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Celebrate Cash the house donkeys birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​走向循環的終點,隨著乾季降臨,濱水獅群重新享受良好的狩獵成果,並在自己的領土裡恢復信心.最後慶祝前外來者愛因斯坦的成功,他現在已經開始真正行使王者的責任,成為屬於他自己的獅群之王.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Come full circle as the dry season descends and the Waterfront Pride enjoys good hunting and renewed confidence in their territory. Then celebrate the success of former outsider Einstein, who gets down to business as the king of his very own pride.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冰島,只有六分一的幼崽能倖存.被父母拋棄的她唯有靠自己.馴鹿群在未結冰的水裡游了兩英里.每年的繁殖季節有35,000隻灰海豹來到蘇格蘭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探小熊們在夏季如何學習爬樹和覓食,為重返野外生活做好準備.迎接一批新成員驚喜入營,見證熊寶貝們進入冬眠前的大吃特吃,並享受一場盛大的小熊感恩祭.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prepare for the summer cubs release with Roger, then meet Ace and Little Blueberry, two newbies with serious health issues who will have to stay over the winter with the Z cubs. Later, celebrate as six healthy, happy bears embark on their new life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 影子獸醫貝克 (Bec) 為被狗咬傷的考拉瑞秋 (Rachel) 包扎傷口,新手獸醫魯比 (Ruby) 和克里恩 (Kerryn) 負責安撫一群不安分的負鼠.與救援人員丹妮 (Dani) 一起解救一對被困在墻上的笑翠鳥,並觀看獸醫蒂姆 (Tim) 為松鼠袋鼯進行的膝蓋手術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shadow vet Bec, who patches up dog-bitten koala Rachel, and new vets Ruby and Kerryn, who soothe a pack of itchy possums. Free a pair of kookaburras trapped in a wall with rescue officer Dani and watch vet Tims squirrel glider knee surgery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 澳洲擁有各種別樹一幟的生物,成功成為王者的方式也同樣多樣性.海灘變成決鬥場,內陸成了拳擊場,動物們同室干戈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Australia is home to an eclectic array of creatures, and the ways to succeed as an alpha are just as diverse. The beach turns into a dueling ground, and the outback becomes a boxing ring, as animals face off with their own kind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佛羅里達群島是美國南部的第一道防線.憑藉豐富的海軍歷史和沿海生活方式,不難相信當地人聲稱那是多達1000艘沉船殘骸的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Florida Keys is the first line of defence for the southern US. With a rich naval history and a coastal lifestyle, its easy to believe locals who claim these waters are home to as many as 1000 shipwrecks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象:克雷格,帕斯卡與以掃.深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言,複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the worlds largest land mammal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 白眉長臂猿是印度叢林的專家.生活在親密的家庭中,少猴花費數年時間學習生存的技能.為你介紹沙馬,牠尋找食物,避開掠食者,並掌握於林木間生活所需的雜技.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hoolock Gibbons are specialists of the Jungle. Living in close knit families, youngsters spend years learning the skills to survive. Meet Samar as he forages for food, avoids predators, and masters the acrobatics required for a life in the trees.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 印度東北部的草原是地球上最肥沃的棲息地之一,該處生長茂盛的野草,讓罕見的印度犀牛賴以維生,並茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The grasslands of Northeast India are one of the most fertile habitats on earth. Hundreds of species of tall grass flourish here, allowing one of Indias most iconic creatures to thrive... the Greater One-horned Rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拉達克高原是一片極端之地,但西藏野驢是這片草原的王者.跟隨一匹影響一群雌性的種馬,她有機會繁殖下一代,但若然如此,她必須與那些想要牠皇冠的對手作戰!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Ladakh plateau is a land of extremes, but the Tibetan wild ass is the king of this grassland. Follow one stallion as he shadows a herd of females for his chance to sire the next generation, but in doing so, he must battle those wanting his crown!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在灼熱和充滿熱帶風暴的土地上,印度南部平原的生活十分艱苦.但一頭帶著兩隻幼崽的雌性樹懶比比,正迎接她生活上的挑戰,她每刻都要對抗缺水缺糧和掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a land of heat and tropical storms, life on the plains of southern India is tough. But Bibi, a female sloth bear with two cubs, is up for the challenge of her life as she fights against drought, food scarcity, and predators around every corner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球上最具代表性的動物之一 - 孟加拉虎在印度的叢林中徘徊.在一天的過程中,我們追隨一位母親和三隻幼崽. 她必須為家人提供足夠的食物來維持生計.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the most iconic animals on Earth stalks the jungles of India: the Bengal Tiger. Over the course of a single day, we follow the fortunes of one mother and her three young cubs. She must provide enough food for her family to stay alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​來認識「濱水」獅群的成員吧:雄獅湯姆・湯姆與卡勒,八隻雌獅,十頭年輕的獅子,以及愛因斯坦,那頭從未離開家園,如今已長成的幼獅.當愛因斯坦的反叛之舉逐漸發酵,最終在「外來者」獅群的對手發動攻勢時,為他釘下了命運的定局.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get to know the Waterfront Pride: males Tom Tom and Caller, 8 lionesses, 10 youths, and Einstein, the grown cub who never left home. Watch Einsteins defiance catch up with him when rivals from the Outsiders Pride make a play that seals his fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙熱高溫,當獅群努力狩獵足夠食物,乾旱條件逼迫他們與獵物一同陷入接近死亡的險境,生命幾乎被推向邊緣.觀看愛因斯坦適應孤獨生活,然後評估戰場殘局,在新手母親卡爾維茲為幼崽性命而奮戰之後.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat when the pride tries to hunt down adequate food as drought conditions push them (and their prey) dangerously close to death. Watch Einstein adapt to solo life, then assess the damage after new mom Kalwezi fights for her cubs lives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​面對雨季的挑戰,這個季節讓一切轉為綠意盎然,同時破壞了獅子隱蔽的保護色,掩飾效果徹底失靈.觀看愛因斯坦無法建立新的聯繫,並權衡得失,在琪薩與牠的幼崽被敵對雄獅瘋眼穆迪綁走之時.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Contend with the challenges of the rainy season, which turns everything green and spoils the lions camouflage. Watch Einstein fail to make new connections and weigh the pros and cons when Keeza and her cub are kidnapped by rival male Mad-Eye Moody.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​迎來豐饒季節的問候,當洪水退去,大群獵物再度回到喬貝河岸邊,重現成群聚集的壯觀場景.觀看琪薩帶著幼崽嘗試逃離,卡勒與湯湯則與對手搏鬥激戰,然後歡呼愛因斯坦終於找到配偶.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Say hello to a season of plenty as flood waters recede and vast herds of prey return to the Chobes banks. Watch Keeza and her cub make a break for it while Caller and Tom Tom brawl with their enemies, then cheer when Einstein finally finds a mate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​走向循環的終點,隨著乾季降臨,濱水獅群重新享受良好的狩獵成果,並在自己的領土裡恢復信心.最後慶祝前外來者愛因斯坦的成功,他現在已經開始真正行使王者的責任,成為屬於他自己的獅群之王.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Come full circle as the dry season descends and the Waterfront Pride enjoys good hunting and renewed confidence in their territory. Then celebrate the success of former outsider Einstein, who gets down to business as the king of his very own pride.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟著各式各樣的鯊魚在海洋中巡游,看看為什麼這些掠食性魚類能夠稱霸海底世界.和礁鯊一起穿梭在珊瑚迷宮之中,和鬚鯊一起潛伏等待最完美的攻擊時機,並和大白鯊一起展開史詩般的大遷徙.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中.與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與地球上最快的動物運動員一起加速.觀看死亡加德蛇在瞬間出擊,與遊隼一起進行空中暗殺,與變色龍一起捕捉快速的食物,並面對在海雀俯衝獵物時的驚人G力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​體驗超越人類能力的動物技能.看看鹹水鱷魚如何利用其壓力敏感的圓頂檢測最微小的動作,發現鴿子的內部GPS系統,並利用第七感與海豚一起檢測獵物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeons internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #1
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七隻飢腸轆轆的大熊剛從冬眠中甦醒過來,挑戰隨即展開!一起見證新手媽媽如何與狼群作戰,身型細小的跺跺如何爭奪地盤和金鬆少女的愛,並旁觀老練的伯尼如何與出其不己的少年卡薩諾瓦搏鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondies love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #2
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與初賽的優勝者和一些強悍的新挑戰者一起投入這場瘋狂的衝刺,迎接他們的在七月洄游的鮭魚!跟隨大男孩踏上尋找美食之旅,並歡迎紅背兒參加盛宴;再看看新手媽媽能否保護她僅存的小熊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join the frantic dash to cash in on Julys salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBois food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

epg.programme_title_tc: 飢餓遊戲:阿拉斯加的大熊挑戰 #3
epg.programme_title_en: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge 1 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 挑戰者一一提起精神,因為十月的寒流使局面變得更加複雜.看看大男孩在絆倒後如何重新振作,然後見證悲劇降臨四子之母.為粉絲最愛的新手媽媽和她的黏人的小孩加油.挑戰來到尾聲,誰會成為最終的皇者?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在智利託雷斯德爾潘恩,雪山融水注入指狀峽灣,延伸至海洋並匯入洋流,降低海水鹽度.河口,濕地孕育眾多涉禽,而無數海灣與港口則吸引稀有的海豚與虎鯨.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Chiles Torres del Paine melt from snow-covered mountains feeds finger-like fjords as they reach out to the sea to join the current lowering its salinity. Rivers estuaries and wetlands are home to many wading birds and the countless inlets and bay

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 洪堡洋流雖比多數洋流緩慢,卻是世界上最具活力的洋流之一,因其行經距離極長.深海海溝的湧升流將養分帶至海面,使浮遊植物大量繁盛,奠定複雜海洋食物鏈的基礎.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Humboldt Current is slower than most ocean currents but it’s the most dynamic in the world because it travels for such a long distance. Upwelling from the deepest trenches brings nutrients to the surface allowing phytoplankton to bloom laying the

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿回鄉與饒舌歌手海特什夏爾馬一起製作素雪糕,然後繞回家品嚐媽媽做的埃及菜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena returns to his home town and makes vegan ice cream with musician Tesher, then swings home to get a taste of his mums Egyptian cooking.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班的美食故事之旅從南方深處開展,他在當地瞭解到為何羊肉如此美味.他認識到最早出產松露的先驅,又乘坐直升機在菲奧德蘭國家公園尋找馬鹿.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben’s food story journey starts in the deep south where he learns why lamb tastes so good. He meets the earliest pioneers producing truffles and travels by helicopter into Fiordland in search of Wapiti.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班到北地大區旅行並瞭解當地的紅酒.他發現一個花生農場,遇到種熱帶木瓜的人,又結識一班以前所未有方式培育紐西蘭黃尾鰤的科學家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben travels to Northland and learns about wine in the region. He discovers a peanut farm, meets tropical papaya fruit growers and catches up with a team of scientists cultivating kingfish like never before.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘆筍當造 - 班挑選3個品種.他遇到一位農民,瞭解到穀飼牛的好處.班追隨注重自耕蔬果的土壤姐妹運動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s asparagus season - Ben picks the 3 varieties. He meets a farmer and understands the benefits of grass-fed beef. Ben catches up with the 『Soil Sisters』 a movement focussed on growing your own fruit and vegetables.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班參觀可持續養殖的綠殼青口養殖場,又參觀花生醬工廠.他到坎特伯雷見一個鴕鳥農夫,並第一次烹煮鴕鳥!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben checks out a sustainably farmed Green Shell Mussel Farm and visits a peanut butter factory. He travels to Canterbury to meet an ostrich farmer and cooks ostrich for the first time ever!

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班遇見一位琴酒釀造者和一位義大利肉店商,並讚揚一位致力於永續農產原則的釀酒師.班擠羊奶,並瞭解下一代農夫如何打造多元化業務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben meets a Gin maker, an Italian chacutier and celebrates a wine maker committed to the principles of sustainable farming. Ben milks sheep and learns how next generation farmers are diversifying their business.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班體驗製作芝士的藝術.他遇到一位甜椒生產商並瞭解洋蔥的起源.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben experiences the art of cheese making. He meets a capsicum producer and learns about the provenance of the onion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 達爾文唯一的朱古力師裡奧健弗斯帶佔美參觀自己的精品朱古力咖啡室- 蜜蜂豆豆朱古力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Darwins only chocolatier Leo Cleanthous shows Jimmy around his boutique chocolate cafe, Bumble Bean Chocolates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美參觀達爾文市中心,給自己的餐廳哈紐文一些建議,並烹製他兒時最喜歡的菜式之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy visits the Darwin CBD to offer an insight into his own restaurant, Hanuman, and cooks one of his favourite childhood dishes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往繁忙的湍溪市場,穿梭在熟食檔,農夫和每週採購的當地人之間.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy heads to the bustling Rapid Creek markets, mingling amongst the food stalls, produce growers, and locals out for their weekly shop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美拜訪一些正為希臘文化節準備食物的希臘社區;他到訪色彩繽紛的馬拉克夜市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy meets some of the Greek community preparing food for the Greek cultural festival; he visits the colourful Malak Night Market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美解釋為何北領地頂端地帶擁有全國最好,最新鮮的海鮮;他在達爾文碼頭遇到自學成才的廚師瑞秋西索卡,並學習如何烹製她的招牌菜- 檸檬柚子泥蟹.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy explains why the Top End has some of the countrys best and freshest seafood; Jimmy meets self-taught chef Rachael Ciesolka at a Darwin wharf, and learns how to cook her signature lemon citrus mud crab dish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往偏遠的曼寧立達的阿納姆地沿海社區,在叢林中品嚐美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy travels to the remote Arnhem Land coastal community of Maningrida to get a taste of food out in the bush.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 的美食之旅從南島西岸展開.他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座農場遇見了全紐西蘭唯一的蔓越莓生產者,接著前往布萊克波爾(Blackball)學習臘腸(chorizo)的製作過程.Ben 隨後在海灘上烹調出多道結合這些在地美味的料理,並搭配當地啤酒享用.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben’s food journey starts in the West Coast of the South Island. He meets the only NZ cranberry producer at a farm in Hokitika and travels to Blackball to learn how chorizo is made. He cooks a range of dishes at the beach incorporating these local de

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 來到坎特伯裡的高峰牧場,了解這座高地農場從產地到餐桌的體驗,以及家族世代守護土地的故事.接著,他前往多拉荒野海岸,拜訪一對以永續方式採集海鮮的夫婦--他們以推土機將漁船推進大海,展開一天的捕撈旅程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben visits High Peak Station in Canterbury and learns of their high -country farm to fork experience and tales of multigenerational stewardship. On the wild Tora Coast he meets a couple who harvest kaimoana sustainably - launching their fishing boat

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 來到黑斯廷斯,發現當地以整合式的全方位方法生產草飼安格斯牛肉.他造訪在地農夫市集,認識了許多優秀的本地食品生產者,展現出這個地區豐饒的農產品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben’s travels to Hastings and discovers a holistic fully vertically integrated approach to creating grass fed Angus beef. He ventures to the local farmers market and meets amazing local food producers, reinforcing the abundance of produce grown in th

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 拜訪了一位果園經營者與食品創新專家.他們共同的願景是製作天然,以品種為主導的蘋果汁,並採用世界最先進的技術.他也參觀了位於霍克斯灣地中海型氣候下所培育的超過三十種無花果.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben’s meets an Orchardist and Food Innovation specialist. They have a shared vision to make all natural varietal - led apple juice, using the best technology in the world. He also checks out over 30 varieties of figs grown in the Mediterranean type c

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 搭船前往阿卡羅瓦的一座鮭魚養殖場,了解紐西蘭帝王鮭與大西洋鮭的不同之處.他親自捕撈鮭魚,並在俯瞰港灣的海岸邊烹調.他也介紹了一款高品質的本地食用油,兼具健康與多功能性,體現對本地農業與永續的承諾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben takes a boat to visit a salmon farm in Akaroa and learns the difference between NZ King and Atlantic salmon. He catches salmon and cooks it on the shoreline overlooking the harbour. He checks out a high-quality homegrown culinary oil that’s both

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正值核果盛產季節!Ben 造訪中奧塔哥一個由家族經營的果園,該果園以核果產季長,與土地及社區的緊密連結而聞名.他發現了一座全電力運作的櫻桃農場,將優質外銷櫻桃直接販售給紐西蘭民眾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s stone fruit season! Ben visits a family run orchard in Central Otago known for its long season of stone fruit and a strong connection to the land and community. He discovers an all-electric cherry farm where premium export cherries are sold dire

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 體驗魯阿佩胡地區正崛起的飲食文化,以及悠久的市集園藝歷史.他拜訪了一位第六代農夫,該農夫將一片偏遠荒野打造成繁榮的生態旅遊與高級餐飲目的地,並與一位屢獲殊榮的主廚合作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben experiences the Ruapehu’s region emerging food story and rich history of market gardening. He meets a sixth generation farmer who has turned a remote wilderness into a thriving eco-tourism and fine dining destination, alongside an award winning c

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 達爾文唯一的朱古力師裡奧健弗斯帶佔美參觀自己的精品朱古力咖啡室- 蜜蜂豆豆朱古力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Darwins only chocolatier Leo Cleanthous shows Jimmy around his boutique chocolate cafe, Bumble Bean Chocolates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美參觀達爾文市中心,給自己的餐廳哈紐文一些建議,並烹製他兒時最喜歡的菜式之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy visits the Darwin CBD to offer an insight into his own restaurant, Hanuman, and cooks one of his favourite childhood dishes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往繁忙的湍溪市場,穿梭在熟食檔,農夫和每週採購的當地人之間.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy heads to the bustling Rapid Creek markets, mingling amongst the food stalls, produce growers, and locals out for their weekly shop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美拜訪一些正為希臘文化節準備食物的希臘社區;他到訪色彩繽紛的馬拉克夜市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy meets some of the Greek community preparing food for the Greek cultural festival; he visits the colourful Malak Night Market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美解釋為何北領地頂端地帶擁有全國最好,最新鮮的海鮮;他在達爾文碼頭遇到自學成才的廚師瑞秋西索卡,並學習如何烹製她的招牌菜- 檸檬柚子泥蟹.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy explains why the Top End has some of the countrys best and freshest seafood; Jimmy meets self-taught chef Rachael Ciesolka at a Darwin wharf, and learns how to cook her signature lemon citrus mud crab dish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往偏遠的曼寧立達的阿納姆地沿海社區,在叢林中品嚐美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy travels to the remote Arnhem Land coastal community of Maningrida to get a taste of food out in the bush.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scientist Steve Thomas must risk his reputation, career, and life in order to save mankind from a huge asteroid headed straight for Earth.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: An unmatched meteor shower alerts a scientist, his assistant, and a conspiracy theorist to a massive cover-up and an even massive threat: a meteor aiming to destroy Earth. They race to expose the truth and save the planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《阿姆斯壯》戲劇性,感人且富有洞察力地講述尼爾巖士唐最完整的人生故事-從他在俄亥俄州鄉村的童年到他首次登月-以及伴隨而來非他所願的名人地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dramatic, moving and insightful, Armstrong tells the definitive life story of Neil Armstrong - from his childhood in rural Ohio, through aerial combat in Korea, to his first steps on the Moon - and the unwanted celebrity status that ensued.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看大型軍用C-5銀河運輸機在超過半世紀的服役生涯中多次的高光時刻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch the massive military transport aircraft C-5 Galaxy come up big time and again over its five decades of service

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從古羅馬的工程奇蹟到託斯卡尼中世紀的血腥戰事,還有卡拉拉巨大的大理石採石場,以前所未有的方式穿越義大利中部- 從空中探索它.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From the engineering wonders of ancient Rome to the bloody medieval battles of Tuscany, and the colossal marble quarries of Carrara, journey across Central Italy and discover it like never before - from the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從時尚之都米蘭出發,渡過威尼斯大運河,到達脫俗的多羅米提山脈和色彩繽紛的五漁村海岸,以前所未有的方式從空中探索義大利北部.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey from the fashion capital to Milan, across the great canals of Venice to the otherworldly peaks of the Dolomites and the colorful coast of Cinque Terre to discover Northern Italy like never before - from the air.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 它們的形狀和大小各適其適,是可怕的火山,偉大的古代文明,還有地球上最清澈水域的家.它們就是迷人的義大利島國.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: They come in all shapes and sizes, are home to terrifying volcanoes, magnificent ancient civilizations, and some of the bluest waters on Earth. These are the fascinating worlds of Italys Islands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從巨型媒體帝國的女繼承人到被通緝的重犯,見證1974年的派蒂赫茲綁架奇案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From heiress of a giant media empire to wanted felon, witness the strange saga of the Patty Hearst kidnapping of 1974.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導山姆之子的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immerse yourself in the drama of the Son of Sam murders, presented the way the events were covered at the time.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著日照越短,天氣越寒冷,加拿大的野生動物正與時間競賽,任何無法好好利用秋天作準備的動物都將滅亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With days growing shorter and colder, Canadian wildlife is in a race against time, and any animal that fails to make the most of what autumn has to offer will perish.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加拿大的冬天既殘酷又美麗;動物們在冰天雪地裡掙扎求存;不過,雖然有些動物會靜候蓄力,另一些需要撫養孩子的動物則需要迅速適應環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Canada is both cruel and beautiful; in the grip of snow and ice, and animals are struggling; however, while some animals hunker down, others have babies to raise who need to adjust to their environment swiftly.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今年有一個遲來的春天,但當它終於來到,尋覓配偶和組織家庭的競賽就正式開展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的樹蛙,東部的兩萬隻塘鵝,不分地域都想著同一件事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring is late this year, and when it finally arrives, the race is on to find a mate and start a family; black bears and beavers in the west, wood frogs in the south and 20,000 gannets in the east all have one thing on their minds.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the heart of the Valdees Peninsula, in Patagonia, whales are regularly hunted by a predator whose diminutive size hides its gruesome intentions: the seagull, forcing whales to dive deep into the depths, away from essential oxygen and light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本週,修復師 Adriana 清潔一座唐納泰羅雕像,西蒙收到海倫・米倫在《女王登場》中穿過的戲服,克裡斯多福會見設計師肯尼斯・格蘭奇爵士,而 VA 鄧迪館邀請藝術家 Yinka Ilori 設計一座色彩繽紛的迷宮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This week, conservator Adriana cleans a Donatello sculpture, Simon receives Helen Mirrens costume from The Audience, Christopher meets designer Sir Kenneth Grange, and VA Dundee recruits artist Yinka Ilori for a colorful maze.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《恐龍效應》是一部關於現今加拿大古生物學復興的紀錄片,恐龍能怎樣教導我們有關氣候變化的知識.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Dinosaur Echo is a documentary about the renaissance of paleontology in Canada today and what dinosaurs can teach us about climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索潘塔納爾濕地400平方英裡的地區,這裡由美洲豹統治,生命都遵循著水的季節節奏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore a 400 square mile region of the Pantanal where jaguars rule and life follows the seasonal rhythm of the water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葡萄牙多元化的地貌孕育了獨特的野生生態.從南部的西班牙栓皮櫟森林到北部的落葉林,從交配到野外生存,跟隨標誌性物種所經歷的關鍵生命階段.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Portugal’s diverse landscapes host unique wildlife. From Cork Oak forests in the south to deciduous forests in the north, follow iconic species through key life phases, from mating to survival in the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 河流是葡萄牙野生生態的生命線,連接山脈到大海.探索成年雄鹿,青蛙的春季儀式和鸊鷉的舞蹈,還有這些生機勃勃的水道沿岸上其他動物和地貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rivers are lifelines in Wild Portugal, connecting mountains to the sea. Discover the Deer stag, frogs spring rituals, and Grebes dances, along with other animals and landscapes along these vital waterways.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 達爾文唯一的朱古力師裡奧健弗斯帶佔美參觀自己的精品朱古力咖啡室- 蜜蜂豆豆朱古力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Darwins only chocolatier Leo Cleanthous shows Jimmy around his boutique chocolate cafe, Bumble Bean Chocolates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美參觀達爾文市中心,給自己的餐廳哈紐文一些建議,並烹製他兒時最喜歡的菜式之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy visits the Darwin CBD to offer an insight into his own restaurant, Hanuman, and cooks one of his favourite childhood dishes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往繁忙的湍溪市場,穿梭在熟食檔,農夫和每週採購的當地人之間.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy heads to the bustling Rapid Creek markets, mingling amongst the food stalls, produce growers, and locals out for their weekly shop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美拜訪一些正為希臘文化節準備食物的希臘社區;他到訪色彩繽紛的馬拉克夜市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy meets some of the Greek community preparing food for the Greek cultural festival; he visits the colourful Malak Night Market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美解釋為何北領地頂端地帶擁有全國最好,最新鮮的海鮮;他在達爾文碼頭遇到自學成才的廚師瑞秋西索卡,並學習如何烹製她的招牌菜- 檸檬柚子泥蟹.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy explains why the Top End has some of the countrys best and freshest seafood; Jimmy meets self-taught chef Rachael Ciesolka at a Darwin wharf, and learns how to cook her signature lemon citrus mud crab dish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往偏遠的曼寧立達的阿納姆地沿海社區,在叢林中品嚐美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy travels to the remote Arnhem Land coastal community of Maningrida to get a taste of food out in the bush.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從奧克拉荷馬州契科塔的小鎮農場出發,走上世界最大舞臺--凱莉.安德伍的旅程,是一個關於夢想,歌聲,以及無法被忽視的熱情的故事.這就是凱莉.安德伍的傳奇--從美國甜心蛻變為當代樂壇的活傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From a small-town farm in Checotah, Oklahoma, to the biggest stages in the world - Carrie Underwood’s journey is the story of a dream, a voice, and a fire that couldn’t be ignored. This is the story of Carrie Underwood - the all-American girl who bec

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穆罕默德阿里是有史以來最偉大的拳擊手,至今仍是全球標誌.他的名字依舊令人尊敬.聽聽那些認識他的人,重溫他的傳奇戰鬥,並探索拳擊界最偉大象徵的一生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Muhammad Ali, the greatest fighter ever, remains a global icon. His name still commands respect. Hear from those who knew him, relive his legendary fights, and explore the life of boxing’s greatest symbol.

epg.programme_title_tc: 茱莉亞羅勃茲:美麗標誌
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索好萊塢最受喜愛的女星 Julia Roberts 的非凡人生.從《麻雀變鳳凰》的突破性演出,到奧斯卡獲獎角色,本片呈現她的成長歷程,持久魅力與對影壇的深遠影響,刻畫一位令人難忘的巨星.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the extraordinary life of Julia Roberts, Hollywood’s beloved icon. From her breakout role in Pretty Woman to her Oscar-winning performances, this documentary explores her journey, enduring charm, and impact on cinema, capturing the heart of

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由著名英國演員比爾奈伊聲音導航,這部優質的自然歷史系列揭示令人震驚和稀有的生物所面臨的挑戰,同時造就牠們家園獨特的環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Narrated by acclaimed English actor Bill Nighy, this blue-chip natural history series reveals the challenges faced by the astounding and rare creatures that make this unique environment their home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由著名英國演員比爾奈伊聲音導航,這部優質的自然歷史系列揭示令人震驚和稀有的生物所面臨的挑戰,同時造就牠們家園獨特的環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Narrated by acclaimed English actor Bill Nighy, this blue-chip natural history series reveals the challenges faced by the astounding and rare creatures that make this unique environment their home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識科學家們認為是生命及如何進化的故事的關鍵生物:安樂蜥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the creature that scientists believe is the key to the story of life and how it evolves: the anole.

epg.programme_title_en: Growing Up Grizzly: A Tale Of Two Orphans
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱西安達臣撫養一隻名叫砵突士的熊孤兒18年後,將盡一切努力確保沒有熊生活在人造庇護所中.有一年,當他得知有兩隻灰熊幼崽成為孤兒後,他的決心受到考驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After 18 years of raising an orphaned bear named Brutus, Casey Anderson will do anything to ensure no bears have to live in a man made sanctuary. His resolve is put to the test one year when he is notified of 2 recently orphaned grizzly cubs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這具百萬年歷史的巨大杜爾福長毛象骨骸,急需進行世界首創的緊急修復.我們跟隨這個艱鉅的拆卸和重組脆弱化石的過程.透過電腦成像技術(CGI)和博物館知識,這部影片讓這個引人入勝卻鮮為人知的巨型生物重獲生命.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The million-year-old, giant Durfort mammoth skeleton required urgent, world-first restoration. We follow the tricky process of disassembling and reassembling the fragile fossil. Through CGI and museum knowledge, the film brings this fascinating, litt

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 討人喜歡,被視為滑稽的海鸚是冰島的國家象徵,但牠的命運令人擔憂.長達十年,海鸚伴侶停止繁殖.少數當地熱心人士現已動員起來,力挽狂瀾,拯救這種備受喜愛的海鳥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The endearing, comical puffin is Icelands national emblem, but its fate is concerning. For a decade, couples have stopped breeding. A handful of local enthusiasts are now mobilized to save this beloved seabird.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過罕見的檔案錄像審視民權社運人士麥爾坎X的迅速崛起和悲劇下場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See the meteoric rise and tragic end of civil rights activist Malcolm X, captured by rarely seen archival footage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過檔案錄像見證柯林頓總統被彈劾當天的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the story of President Clintons impeachment, presented through archival footage of the day.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證美國南部和中西部如何在短短18小時內遭受148個龍捲風肆虐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness how Americas South and Midwest were ravaged by 148 twisters in just 18 hours.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 它們的形狀和大小各適其適,是可怕的火山,偉大的古代文明,還有地球上最清澈水域的家.它們就是迷人的義大利島國.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: They come in all shapes and sizes, are home to terrifying volcanoes, magnificent ancient civilizations, and some of the bluest waters on Earth. These are the fascinating worlds of Italys Islands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這裡擁有地中海一些最美麗的希臘神廟,似乎漂浮在海上的城市,還有地球上其中一個威力最大的火山,義大利這地區感覺就如平行世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With some of the most beautiful Greek temples on the Mediterranean, cities that just seem to float above the sea, and one of the most powerful volcanoes on Earth, this region of Italy feels like another world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由著名英國演員比爾奈伊聲音導航,這部優質的自然歷史系列揭示令人震驚和稀有的生物所面臨的挑戰,同時造就牠們家園獨特的環境.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葡萄牙沿海水域和亞速爾群島擁有豐富的生態系統.在本集探索生活在這些水域的多元化物種,並發掘牠們獨特的生活.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Portugal’s coastal waters and the Azores archipelago boast rich ecosystems. Explore the diverse species living in these waters and discover their unique lives in this revealing episode.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南太平洋一個偏遠群島的叢林中,一位生物學家正嘗試做著查理斯達爾文和恩斯特邁爾的未竟之事: 在新物種創造過程中捕捉進化的身影.懷艾伯特在索羅門群島即將有一個驚人的發現,但一個危機慢慢逼近.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the jungles of a remote archipelago in the South Pacific, a biologist is attempting to do something Charles Darwin and Ernst Mayr never accomplished: catch evolution in the act of creating new species. Albert Uy is on the verge of an amazing disco

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 體驗魯阿佩胡地區正崛起的飲食文化,以及悠久的市集園藝歷史.他拜訪了一位第六代農夫,該農夫將一片偏遠荒野打造成繁榮的生態旅遊與高級餐飲目的地,並與一位屢獲殊榮的主廚合作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben experiences the Ruapehu’s region emerging food story and rich history of market gardening. He meets a sixth generation farmer who has turned a remote wilderness into a thriving eco-tourism and fine dining destination, alongside an award winning c

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班的美食故事之旅從南方深處開展,他在當地瞭解到為何羊肉如此美味.他認識到最早出產松露的先驅,又乘坐直升機在菲奧德蘭國家公園尋找馬鹿.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben’s food story journey starts in the deep south where he learns why lamb tastes so good. He meets the earliest pioneers producing truffles and travels by helicopter into Fiordland in search of Wapiti.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班到北地大區旅行並瞭解當地的紅酒.他發現一個花生農場,遇到種熱帶木瓜的人,又結識一班以前所未有方式培育紐西蘭黃尾鰤的科學家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben travels to Northland and learns about wine in the region. He discovers a peanut farm, meets tropical papaya fruit growers and catches up with a team of scientists cultivating kingfish like never before.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘆筍當造 - 班挑選3個品種.他遇到一位農民,瞭解到穀飼牛的好處.班追隨注重自耕蔬果的土壤姐妹運動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s asparagus season - Ben picks the 3 varieties. He meets a farmer and understands the benefits of grass-fed beef. Ben catches up with the 『Soil Sisters』 a movement focussed on growing your own fruit and vegetables.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班參觀可持續養殖的綠殼青口養殖場,又參觀花生醬工廠.他到坎特伯雷見一個鴕鳥農夫,並第一次烹煮鴕鳥!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben checks out a sustainably farmed Green Shell Mussel Farm and visits a peanut butter factory. He travels to Canterbury to meet an ostrich farmer and cooks ostrich for the first time ever!

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班遇見一位琴酒釀造者和一位義大利肉店商,並讚揚一位致力於永續農產原則的釀酒師.班擠羊奶,並瞭解下一代農夫如何打造多元化業務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben meets a Gin maker, an Italian chacutier and celebrates a wine maker committed to the principles of sustainable farming. Ben milks sheep and learns how next generation farmers are diversifying their business.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當我們想到好萊塢芸芸眾多藝人時......有一個名字脫穎而出.從他的辛酸到令人難以置信的果報......這就是小勞勃道尼
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When we think of a prolific, yet tumultuous career in Hollywood... A name stands out amongst the crowd. From his hardships to his incredible retribution... This is Robert Downey Jr.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剛登六的湯姆克魯斯仍然是好萊塢頂流之一.作為一位多產的演員,他的職業生涯橫跨40年,不斷在電影界創造巨大的遺產.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Having just turned 60, Tom Cruise is still one of the leading names in Hollywood. A prolific actor with a career spanning over 40 years, he is continually building a giant legacy within the film industry.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著日照越短,天氣越寒冷,加拿大的野生動物正與時間競賽,任何無法好好利用秋天作準備的動物都將滅亡.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With days growing shorter and colder, Canadian wildlife is in a race against time, and any animal that fails to make the most of what autumn has to offer will perish.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加拿大的冬天既殘酷又美麗;動物們在冰天雪地裡掙扎求存;不過,雖然有些動物會靜候蓄力,另一些需要撫養孩子的動物則需要迅速適應環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Canada is both cruel and beautiful; in the grip of snow and ice, and animals are struggling; however, while some animals hunker down, others have babies to raise who need to adjust to their environment swiftly.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今年有一個遲來的春天,但當它終於來到,尋覓配偶和組織家庭的競賽就正式開展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的樹蛙,東部的兩萬隻塘鵝,不分地域都想著同一件事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Spring is late this year, and when it finally arrives, the race is on to find a mate and start a family; black bears and beavers in the west, wood frogs in the south and 20,000 gannets in the east all have one thing on their minds.

epg.programme_title_en: Canada: A Year In The Wild #4

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The end of winter heralds one of the worlds greatest feeding frenzies as large ocean predators target the millions of fish who have found refuge in the Gulf of Alaska.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《阿姆斯壯》戲劇性,感人且富有洞察力地講述尼爾巖士唐最完整的人生故事-從他在俄亥俄州鄉村的童年到他首次登月-以及伴隨而來非他所願的名人地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dramatic, moving and insightful, Armstrong tells the definitive life story of Neil Armstrong - from his childhood in rural Ohio, through aerial combat in Korea, to his first steps on the Moon - and the unwanted celebrity status that ensued.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scientist Steve Thomas must risk his reputation, career, and life in order to save mankind from a huge asteroid headed straight for Earth.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: With days growing shorter and colder, Canadian wildlife is in a race against time, and any animal that fails to make the most of what autumn has to offer will perish.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter in Canada is both cruel and beautiful; in the grip of snow and ice, and animals are struggling; however, while some animals hunker down, others have babies to raise who need to adjust to their environment swiftly.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Marine biologists Eve Jourdain and Richard Kaoliussen have spent two years studying the orcas in Norway, where they have adapted the carrousel technique to their habitat.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Exploring the wilderness and wildlife of the Atlantic Ocean. Winter brings bitter storms, suffering and conflict, while most are battling to survive.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冬天的尾巴,大西洋再度生機盎然.在深海水域過冬的魚群再度回歸.一對老鷹在完美捕魚點的高空築巢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As winter draws to a close, the Atlantic springs back to life. Fish that spent the winter out in the deeper water have returned. An eagle pair has set up home high above the perfect fishing spot.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班參觀可持續養殖的綠殼青口養殖場,又參觀花生醬工廠.他到坎特伯雷見一個鴕鳥農夫,並第一次烹煮鴕鳥!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben checks out a sustainably farmed Green Shell Mussel Farm and visits a peanut butter factory. He travels to Canterbury to meet an ostrich farmer and cooks ostrich for the first time ever!

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班遇見一位琴酒釀造者和一位義大利肉店商,並讚揚一位致力於永續農產原則的釀酒師.班擠羊奶,並瞭解下一代農夫如何打造多元化業務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben meets a Gin maker, an Italian chacutier and celebrates a wine maker committed to the principles of sustainable farming. Ben milks sheep and learns how next generation farmers are diversifying their business.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S3 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 班體驗製作芝士的藝術.他遇到一位甜椒生產商並瞭解洋蔥的起源.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben experiences the art of cheese making. He meets a capsicum producer and learns about the provenance of the onion.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #1

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #2

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben visits High Peak Station in Canterbury and learns of their high -country farm to fork experience and tales of multigenerational stewardship. On the wild Tora Coast he meets a couple who harvest kaimoana sustainably - launching their fishing boat

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben’s travels to Hastings and discovers a holistic fully vertically integrated approach to creating grass fed Angus beef. He ventures to the local farmers market and meets amazing local food producers, reinforcing the abundance of produce grown in th

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Having just turned 60, Tom Cruise is still one of the leading names in Hollywood. A prolific actor with a career spanning over 40 years, he is continually building a giant legacy within the film industry.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is the remarkable journey of one of boxing’s most unstoppable forces. Manny Pacquiao’s legacy will forever be remembered for the change accomplished inside and outside the ring...

epg.programme_title_tc: 米高 J 福克斯:演員樂觀活動家

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Michael J. Foxs life, from his rise to fame to a Parkinsons diagnosis at 29, has been nothing short of a real-life movie, marked by unexpected twists and remarkable resilience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 他可能是最性感的好萊塢演員之一,但他的職業和個人目標比他的外表更有味道.布萊德彼特.整個好萊塢首屈一指的人物之一.一個默默無聞的天才轉變為超級巨星的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: He may be one of the sexiest Hollywood actors, but his career and personal goals offer much more than his looks. Brad Pitt. One of the leading names in all of Hollywood. The well-known story of an unknown talent who transformed into a superstar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《阿姆斯壯》戲劇性,感人且富有洞察力地講述尼爾巖士唐最完整的人生故事-從他在俄亥俄州鄉村的童年到他首次登月-以及伴隨而來非他所願的名人地位.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dramatic, moving and insightful, Armstrong tells the definitive life story of Neil Armstrong - from his childhood in rural Ohio, through aerial combat in Korea, to his first steps on the Moon - and the unwanted celebrity status that ensued.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 科學家史蒂夫託馬斯必須賭上名聲,事業和生命,從一顆直奔地球的巨大小行星中拯救人類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scientist Steve Thomas must risk his reputation, career, and life in order to save mankind from a huge asteroid headed straight for Earth.

epg.programme_title_tc: 前進宇宙:太空,競賽,火星與更遠之處
epg.programme_title_en: Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Ben 搭船前往阿卡羅瓦的一座鮭魚養殖場,了解紐西蘭帝王鮭與大西洋鮭的不同之處.他親自捕撈鮭魚,並在俯瞰港灣的海岸邊烹調.他也介紹了一款高品質的本地食用油,兼具健康與多功能性,體現對本地農業與永續的承諾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ben takes a boat to visit a salmon farm in Akaroa and learns the difference between NZ King and Atlantic salmon. He catches salmon and cooks it on the shoreline overlooking the harbour. He checks out a high-quality homegrown culinary oil that’s both

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正值核果盛產季節!Ben 造訪中奧塔哥一個由家族經營的果園,該果園以核果產季長,與土地及社區的緊密連結而聞名.他發現了一座全電力運作的櫻桃農場,將優質外銷櫻桃直接販售給紐西蘭民眾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It’s stone fruit season! Ben visits a family run orchard in Central Otago known for its long season of stone fruit and a strong connection to the land and community. He discovers an all-electric cherry farm where premium export cherries are sold dire

epg.programme_title_en: A New Zealand Food Story S4 #7
